row.title: Watch the administration App as a credential
row.body: The tick Worker's administration App creates tenant and visitor repositories and sets repo settings when ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN is absent, so it is a SPOF (spof-admin-app) and a credwatch row (GITHUB_ADMIN_APP) probed daily with a dry repo-settings read through the site Worker's OIDC route; nothing is written by the probe.
